name: Dev Tools
description: A lightweight dev toolset under 200KB — instant to use. Sandboxed and offline with zero network access. High-frequency tools for crypto, encoding, text, data conversion, formatting, time, networking and image generation; inputs and options are remembered and sync seamlessly across devices via DBX.
releaseNotes: 新增：时间工具的「时间详情」卡片支持选择显示时区，墙钟时间、星期、年积日、ISO 周等全部跟随所选时区；时区选择器优化——聚焦展开完整列表、选项标注当前偏移、支持直接输入数字（如 8）匹配 ±N 小时时区、聚焦自动全选便于替换；「时间戳」模式更名「日期时间」并补充输入格式提示。 | New: the time tool's details card now has a display-timezone picker — wall clock, weekday, day-of-year and ISO week all follow the chosen zone; the timezone picker got a usability pass — full list on focus, per-option current offsets, bare-digit queries like 8 matching ±N-hour zones, and select-all on focus for quick replacement; the Timestamp mode is renamed Date & time with an input-format hint.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 不到 200KB 的轻量开发者工具集，即开即用。沙箱离线运行，零网络权限。涵盖加解密、编解码、文本处理、数据转换、格式化、时间计算、网络运维、图像生成等众多高频工具；参数自动记忆，配置可随 DBX 跨端无缝同步。
